description: Talos Kubernetes cluster health across every compute dimension: nodes, workloads, CPU/memory saturation, network, storage, GPUs, and control plane. Metrics via OTEL kubeletstats + k8sclusterreceiver + DCGM + istiod.

panels.description: Nodes reporting Ready=1 out of total nodes in the cluster.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Ready' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS h, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.condition_ready' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY h)

SELECT 'Total' AS label, toFloat64(count()) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS h, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.condition_ready' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY h)

panels.title: Nodes Ready

panels.description: Pods in phase Running (k8s_pod_phase == 2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(countIf(v=2)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

panels.title: Running Pods

panels.description: Pods in phase Pending (k8s_pod_phase == 1). Stuck scheduling, image pull, or PVC bind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

panels.title: Pending Pods

panels.description: Pods in phase Failed (k8s_pod_phase == 4). Investigate restart policy / exit codes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(countIf(v=4)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

panels.title: Failed Pods

panels.description: Cluster CPU utilization: sum(kubelet CPU usage) / sum(kube-state-metrics node allocatable CPU). Matches `kubectl top nodes` totals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT '% used' AS label, (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.cpu.utilization' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) / nullIf((SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['node'])),0) AS value

SELECT 'cores used' AS label, (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.cpu.utilization' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) AS value

SELECT 'cores total' AS label, (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['node'])) AS value

SELECT 'cores committed' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(s) AS s FROM (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node))) AS value

SELECT '% committed' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(s) AS s FROM (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node))) / nullIf((SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node))),0) AS value

panels.title: Cluster CPU

panels.description: Byte-weighted cluster memory utilization: sum(working set) / sum(working set + available). Matches `kubectl top nodes` totals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT '% used' AS label, (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) / nullIf((SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) + (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.available' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])),0) AS value

SELECT 'used' AS label, (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) AS value

SELECT 'total' AS label, (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) + (SELECT sum(v) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.available' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['host_name'])) AS value

SELECT 'committed' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(s) AS s FROM (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='memory' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node))) AS value

SELECT '% committed' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(s) AS s FROM (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='memory' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node))) / nullIf((SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='memory' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node))),0) AS value

panels.description: Average GPU utilization across all DCGM-reporting GPUs.

panels.description: New container restarts in the last hour (increase on k8s_container_restarts).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(d),0) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Value, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if(Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.container.restarts' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 70 MINUTE) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Restarts (1h)

panels.description: Sum of available deployment replicas across namespaces. Drop below desired = rollout stalled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Available' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.deployment.available' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

SELECT 'Desired' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.deployment.desired' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

panels.title: Deployments

panels.description: StatefulSet pods ready vs desired.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Ready' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.statefulset.ready_pods' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

SELECT 'Desired' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.statefulset.desired_pods' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

panels.description: DaemonSet nodes ready vs desired. Misscheduled > 0 flags a problem.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Ready' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

SELECT 'Desired' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

SELECT 'Misschd' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.daemonset.misscheduled_nodes' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Active' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.job.active_pods' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

SELECT 'Failed' AS label, coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.job.failed_pods' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes)

panels.description: All pods grouped by lifecycle phase (Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed/Unknown).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Pending' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

SELECT 'Running' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=2)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

SELECT 'Succeeded' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=3)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

SELECT 'Failed' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=4)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

SELECT 'Unknown' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=5)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY s)

panels.title: Pods by Phase

panels.description: Per-node health snapshot: readiness, CPU, memory, filesystem, pod density. One row per node.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.host_name AS host_name, r.v AS "Ready", cpu.v AS "CPU (cores)", ws.v / nullIf(ws.v + av.v,0) AS "Memory %", (ws.v + av.v) / 1000000000 AS "Memory (GiB)", fu.v / nullIf(fc.v,0) AS "Disk %", fc.v / 1000000000 AS "Disk (GiB)", toFloat64(coalesce(pods.c,0)) AS "Pods", toFloat64(coalesce(gpus.c,0)) AS "GPUs"
FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.condition_ready' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.cpu.utilization' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) cpu ON r.host_name=cpu.host_name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) ws ON r.host_name=ws.host_name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.available' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) av ON r.host_name=av.host_name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.filesystem.usage' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) fu ON r.host_name=fu.host_name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.filesystem.capacity' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) fc ON r.host_name=fc.host_name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT host_name, countIf(v=2) AS c FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name, s) GROUP BY host_name) pods ON r.host_name=pods.host_name
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hn AS host_name, count() AS c FROM (SELECT Attributes['Hostname'] AS hn, Attributes['gpu'] AS g, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY hn, g, Attributes['pod'], Attributes['namespace']) GROUP BY host_name) gpus ON r.host_name=gpus.host_name
ORDER BY host_name

panels.title: Nodes Overview

panels.description: Per-node CPU cores in use (kubelet CPU usage).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.cpu.utilization' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY time, host_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Node CPU (cores used)

panels.description: Per-node memory used / total.

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.time AS time, w.host_name AS host_name, w.ws / nullIf(w.ws + a.av,0) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, avg(Value) AS ws FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, host_name) w INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, avg(Value) AS av FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.memory.available' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, host_name) a ON w.time=a.time AND w.host_name=a.host_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Node Memory Utilization

panels.description: Per-node root filesystem usage as percent of capacity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.host_name AS host_name, u.v / nullIf(c.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.filesystem.usage' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) u INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.filesystem.capacity' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY host_name) c ON u.host_name=c.host_name

panels.title: Node Filesystem %

panels.description: Aggregate pod network throughput rolled up per node (rx + tx).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, concat(host_name, ' rx') AS host_name, value FROM (SELECT tb AS time, host_name, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS value FROM (SELECT tb, host_name, attrs, sum(diff) AS d FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes AS attrs, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if(Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS diff FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.network.io' AND Attributes['direction']='receive' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime) WHERE tb >= $__fromTime GROUP BY tb, host_name, attrs) GROUP BY time, host_name ORDER BY time)

SELECT time, concat(host_name, ' tx') AS host_name, value FROM (SELECT tb AS time, host_name, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS value FROM (SELECT tb, host_name, attrs, sum(diff) AS d FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes AS attrs, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if(Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS diff FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.network.io' AND Attributes['direction']='transmit' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime) WHERE tb >= $__fromTime GROUP BY tb, host_name, attrs) GROUP BY time, host_name ORDER BY time)

panels.title: Node Network (pod aggregate)

panels.description: Count of pods in each phase over time. Running should dominate; Pending/Failed spikes indicate scheduling or crash issues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tb AS time, 'Pending' AS phase, toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY tb, s) GROUP BY tb ORDER BY tb

SELECT tb AS time, 'Running' AS phase, toFloat64(countIf(v=2)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY tb, s) GROUP BY tb ORDER BY tb

SELECT tb AS time, 'Succeeded' AS phase, toFloat64(countIf(v=3)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY tb, s) GROUP BY tb ORDER BY tb

SELECT tb AS time, 'Failed' AS phase, toFloat64(countIf(v=4)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY tb, s) GROUP BY tb ORDER BY tb

SELECT tb AS time, 'Unknown' AS phase, toFloat64(countIf(v=5)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS s, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.phase' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY tb, s) GROUP BY tb ORDER BY tb

panels.title: Pods by Phase (over time)

panels.description: Containers with the most restarts in the last hour. Hot spots for crash loops and OOMs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT service_name, service_namespace, host_name, sum(d) AS "Restarts (1h)", argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS "Total Restarts" FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Value, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if(Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.container.restarts' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 70 MINUTE) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace, host_name HAVING sum(d) > 0 ORDER BY "Restarts (1h)" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Restarting Containers (1h)

panels.description: Deployment available vs desired per namespace. Gap > 0 means at least one deployment is under-replicated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.service_namespace AS service_namespace, d.v AS Desired, a.v AS Available, d.v - a.v AS Gap FROM (SELECT service_namespace, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.deployment.desired' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY service_namespace, ServiceName, Attributes) GROUP BY service_namespace) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT service_namespace, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.deployment.available' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY service_namespace, ServiceName, Attributes) GROUP BY service_namespace) a ON d.service_namespace=a.service_namespace ORDER BY Gap DESC

panels.title: Deployments — Desired vs Available

panels.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler current vs desired replicas by namespace. Persistent mismatch = throttled or waiting on pods.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_namespace, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['service_namespace'], ' current') AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.hpa.current_replicas' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_namespace, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, service_namespace ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service_namespace, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['service_namespace'], ' desired') AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.hpa.desired_replicas' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_namespace, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, service_namespace ORDER BY time

panels.title: HPA — Current vs Desired Replicas

panels.description: Top N pods by CPU usage (cores used).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_name, value FROM (SELECT time, service_name, value, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY avgv DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, avg(Value) AS value, avg(avg(Value)) OVER (PARTITION BY Attributes['service_name']) AS avgv FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.cpu.utilization' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_name)) WHERE rnk <= $topN ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Pods — CPU

panels.description: Top N pods by memory usage (bytes).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_name, value FROM (SELECT time, service_name, value, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY avgv DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, avg(Value) AS value, avg(avg(Value)) OVER (PARTITION BY Attributes['service_name']) AS avgv FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_name)) WHERE rnk <= $topN ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Pods — Memory (working set)

panels.description: Containers using >70% of their memory limit — OOMKill candidates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.service_name AS service_name, u.service_namespace AS service_namespace, u.v AS Usage, l.v AS "Limit", u.v / nullIf(l.v,0) AS "Usage / Limit" FROM (SELECT service_name, service_namespace, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace, ServiceName, Attributes) GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace) u INNER JOIN (SELECT service_name, service_namespace, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.container.memory_limit' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace, ServiceName, Attributes) GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace) l ON u.service_name=l.service_name AND u.service_namespace=l.service_namespace WHERE l.v > 0 AND u.v / l.v > 0.5 ORDER BY "Usage / Limit" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Memory Pressure — Pods Near Limit

panels.description: CPU cores requested vs used per namespace. Large gaps = over-reserved capacity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_namespace, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['service_namespace'], ' used') AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.cpu.utilization' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_namespace, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, service_namespace ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service_namespace, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['service_namespace'], ' requested') AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.container.cpu_request' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_namespace, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, service_namespace ORDER BY time

panels.title: CPU: Used vs Requested (per namespace)

panels.description: Memory working-set vs requested bytes per namespace.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_namespace, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['service_namespace'], ' used') AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_namespace, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, service_namespace ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service_namespace, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['service_namespace'], ' requested') AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.container.memory_request' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, service_namespace, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, service_namespace ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory: Used vs Requested (per namespace)

panels.description: Top pods by ingress (receive) rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_name, value FROM (SELECT time, service_name, value, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY avgv DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT time, service_name, value, avg(value) OVER (PARTITION BY service_name) AS avgv FROM (SELECT tb AS time, service_name, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS value FROM (SELECT tb, service_name, attrs, sum(diff) AS d FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes AS attrs, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if((Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS diff FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.network.io' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND Attributes['direction']='receive' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime) WHERE tb >= $__fromTime GROUP BY tb, service_name, attrs) GROUP BY time, service_name))) WHERE rnk <= $topN ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Pods — Network RX

panels.description: Top pods by egress (transmit) rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_name, value FROM (SELECT time, service_name, value, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY avgv DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT time, service_name, value, avg(value) OVER (PARTITION BY service_name) AS avgv FROM (SELECT tb AS time, service_name, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS value FROM (SELECT tb, service_name, attrs, sum(diff) AS d FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes AS attrs, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if((Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS diff FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.network.io' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND Attributes['direction']='transmit' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime) WHERE tb >= $__fromTime GROUP BY tb, service_name, attrs) GROUP BY time, service_name))) WHERE rnk <= $topN ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Pods — Network TX

panels.description: Pods with non-zero network error rate (rx+tx errors). Healthy baseline is 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service_name, direction, value FROM (SELECT time, service_name, direction, value, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY avgv DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT time, service_name, direction, value, avg(value) OVER (PARTITION BY service_name, direction) AS avgv FROM (SELECT tb AS time, service_name, direction, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS value FROM (SELECT tb, service_name, direction, attrs, sum(diff) AS d FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['direction'] AS direction, Attributes AS attrs, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if((Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS diff FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.network.errors' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime) WHERE tb >= $__fromTime GROUP BY tb, service_name, direction, attrs) GROUP BY time, service_name, direction))) WHERE rnk <= 10 AND value > 0 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pod Network Errors

panels.description: Top pods by ephemeral filesystem bytes used. Growing rapidly = log rot / missing rotation / leak.

targets.rawSql: SELECT service_name, service_namespace, sum(v) AS Usage FROM (SELECT Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['service_namespace'] AS service_namespace, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.pod.filesystem.usage' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['service_namespace'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}), $namespace) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace, ServiceName, Attributes) GROUP BY service_name, service_namespace ORDER BY Usage DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top Pods — Ephemeral Filesystem

panels.description: Node filesystem usage trend. Trajectory matters more than the value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.time AS time, u.host_name AS host_name, u.v / nullIf(c.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.filesystem.usage' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, host_name) u INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='k8s.node.filesystem.capacity' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, host_name) c ON u.time=c.time AND u.host_name=c.host_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Node Filesystem — Trend

panels.description: Per-GPU SM utilization. Sustained high means the GPU is the bottleneck; idle means capacity to schedule more work.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu']) AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: Framebuffer memory used per GPU (MiB).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu'], ' used') AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

SELECT u.time AS time, concat(u.h, ' gpu', u.g, ' total') AS gpu, u.v + f.v AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['Hostname'] AS h, Attributes['gpu'] AS g, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, h, g) u INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['Hostname'] AS h, Attributes['gpu'] AS g, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, h, g) f ON u.time=f.time AND u.h=f.h AND u.g=f.g ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPU Memory

panels.description: GPU die temperature. NVIDIA thermal throttle typically starts ~87°C.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu']) AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPU Temperature

panels.description: Instantaneous GPU power draw in watts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu']) AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPU Power

panels.description: Workload intensity: tensor-core and SM pipelines active fraction. Tensor active correlates with FP16/BF16/FP8 matmul heavy workloads.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu'], ' SM') AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu'], ' tensor') AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['Hostname'], ' gpu', Attributes['gpu'], ' DRAM') AS gpu, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, gpu ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPU Compute Pipeline Activity

panels.description: Pods currently scheduled on each GPU. Memory figures are per-GPU totals, not per-pod.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.namespace AS namespace, u.pod AS pod, u.Hostname AS Hostname, u.gpu AS gpu, u.v AS "GPU Util %", m.v AS "GPU Mem (MiB)" FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['Hostname'] AS Hostname, Attributes['gpu'] AS gpu, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY namespace, pod, Hostname, gpu) u INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['Hostname'] AS Hostname, Attributes['gpu'] AS gpu, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY namespace, pod, Hostname, gpu) m ON u.namespace=m.namespace AND u.pod=m.pod AND u.Hostname=m.Hostname AND u.gpu=m.gpu ORDER BY "GPU Util %" DESC

panels.title: Pods on GPU

panels.description: xDS pushes per second by type. Sustained high = churn in config/endpoints.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tb AS time, type, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS value FROM (SELECT tb, type, attrs, sum(diff) AS d FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS tb, Attributes['type'] AS type, Attributes AS attrs, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix) = 1, 0, if((Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) < 0, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix))) AS diff FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='pilot_xds_pushes' AND 1=1 AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime) WHERE tb >= $__fromTime GROUP BY tb, type, attrs) GROUP BY time, type ORDER BY time

panels.title: xDS Pushes

panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 proxy convergence time. Spikes mean data plane is slow to pick up config.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, 'p50' AS quantile, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.5)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (SELECT time, idx, bound, sum(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum FROM (SELECT time, idx, if(idx < length(bounds), bounds[idx+1], toFloat64(Inf)) AS bound, sum(d[idx+1]) AS cnt FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, ExplicitBounds AS bounds, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((a,b) -> greatest(toFloat64(a)-toFloat64(b), 0.), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName='pilot_proxy_convergence_time' AND AggregationTemporality=2 AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes, ExplicitBounds ORDER BY TimeUnix)) ARRAY JOIN range(length(d)) AS idx WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, idx, bounds)) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time, 'p99' AS quantile, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.99)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (SELECT time, idx, bound, sum(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum FROM (SELECT time, idx, if(idx < length(bounds), bounds[idx+1], toFloat64(Inf)) AS bound, sum(d[idx+1]) AS cnt FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, ExplicitBounds AS bounds, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((a,b) -> greatest(toFloat64(a)-toFloat64(b), 0.), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName='pilot_proxy_convergence_time' AND AggregationTemporality=2 AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes, ExplicitBounds ORDER BY TimeUnix)) ARRAY JOIN range(length(d)) AS idx WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, idx, bounds)) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Sum of pod CPU requests divided by total allocatable CPU. >100% means the cluster is overcommitted (pods may be evicted or pending).

targets.rawSql: SELECT '% requested' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(s) AS s FROM (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node))) / nullIf((SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node))),0) AS value

SELECT 'cores requested' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(s) AS s FROM (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node))) AS value

SELECT 'cores allocatable' AS label, (SELECT s FROM (SELECT sum(v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node))) AS value

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'unbound PVCs' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['persistentvolumeclaim'] AS pvc, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase' AND Attributes['phase'] IN ('Pending','Lost') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pvc)

SELECT 'cordoned nodes' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_spec_unschedulable' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node)

SELECT 'node pressure' AS label, toFloat64(countIf(v=1)) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['condition'] AS cond, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_condition' AND Attributes['condition'] IN ('MemoryPressure','DiskPressure','PIDPressure') AND Attributes['status']='true' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node, cond)

panels.title: Scheduling Health

panels.description: Per-node capacity commit: how much of each node's allocatable resources is requested by scheduled pods. Sort by any column to find pressure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.node AS node, rq.s / nullIf(a.v,0) AS "cpu req %", rq.s AS "cpu req", a.v AS "cpu alloc", rm.s / nullIf(am.v,0) AS "mem req %", rm.s AS "mem req", am.v AS "mem alloc", toFloat64(p.c) AS pods, ap.v AS "pod cap", toFloat64(p.c) / nullIf(ap.v,0) AS "pod %"
FROM (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node) a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='cpu' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node) rq ON a.node=rq.node
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='memory' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node) am ON a.node=am.node
LEFT JOIN (SELECT pn.node AS node, sum(r.v) AS s FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS c, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_resource_requests' AND Attributes['resource']='memory' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns,pod,c) r INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending')) = 1) lp ON r.ns=lp.ns AND r.pod=lp.pod INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON r.ns=pn.ns AND r.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node) rm ON a.node=rm.node
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['resource']='pods' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['node'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node) ap ON a.node=ap.node
LEFT JOIN (SELECT pn.node AS node, count() AS c FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod HAVING maxIf(Value, Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running','Pending','Unknown')) = 1) lp INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS ns, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, argMax(Attributes['node'], TimeUnix) AS node FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ns, pod) pn ON lp.ns=pn.ns AND lp.pod=pn.pod WHERE $__conditionalAll(pn.node IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) GROUP BY pn.node) p ON a.node=p.node
ORDER BY node
